text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day in the middle of March, I
stumble upon
Seiun Sky lost in thought.
It's not a side of her I
see often.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm... Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's nothing. Or at least, nothing big.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...But can I ask your opinion on
something?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky opens up, revealing that the
other day,
when she asked Nishino
Flower to be her date to
the Ligne
Droite...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower asked for time to
consider it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Can you believe it? Gaaah...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, maybe it was a
bad
move for me to fall asleep while she
was talking
the other day.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And that time I jumped out of nowhere
while she
was carrying flowers to scare
her probably didn't
help either...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's chattering on like nothing big
happened,
but I can kind of tell by her
face that she's
bummed.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...I thought she could only say yes or no.
Had no
idea there was a third option.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her worried look suggests that she's
wondering
whether Nishino Flower hates
her.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Really?
choice_data_list: 断りたいのならすぐ断ると思う

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: 何か理由があるんじゃないか？
何か理由があるんじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So... it's not because she hates me?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You're probably right. Thanks, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky, back to her usual self,
mutters while
leaving my office, "In that
case, I'll need more
information if I'm
going to win this war."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Dancing's so hard... I don't think I'll ever get the hang of it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So I hold the flower here, and
bend the stem like
this? Is that right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Are you... making a flower crown?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Flower. Hehe, I sure am. It's a
present
for a flower fairy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But it's harder than I thought it'd be.
Turns out my
present's more suited for a
trash can.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No! It's the thought that counts. I'm sure
the
person it's meant for will be over the
moon, since
you worked so hard making
it yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky's conflicted expression softens
into a
satisfied smile.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But anyway, Flower, about your answer
for the
Droite...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You're probably thinking no, right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
N-no, that's not it at all! I'm sure it'd be
really fun
to go to the Droite with you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's just... you're so good at dancing, I
wanted to
try to get good before
answering... I'm sorry I
made you wait so
long.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Lemme tell you something I heard
once.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A prom isn't a dance competition. It's a
place
where you make memories.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So, like...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to be good. I just want
to make
some good memories together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky gently places her poorly made
flower
crown on Nishino Flower's head.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What do you say, flower fairy?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Uh... huh?! Fairy?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You said it yourself... It's the thought
that counts.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, I... That...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yeah... You're right... Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I spot Nishino Flower
smiling as
she heads to the Droite
together with Seiun Sky.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Searching memory for "worries, Nishino
Flower"...
One result found dated last
night, 9:41 p.m.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Contents determined to be relevant.
Initiating
playback.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Sky asked me to the Droite, but she's
such a great
dancer...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not very good, so I'm afraid I'll
embarrass her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm practicing so hard. I need
to
improve before I can say yes. End of
playback.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, now I get it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Analyzing facial expression... You are
feeling
slightly surprised.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... This is a little outside what I was

expecting.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
One foot here, and then the other like
this... Ooh,
I'll never get the hang of this.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I should probably just say
no. But...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Then she might end up going with
someone else.

Ding-ding! It's trivia time! What is the
most
important thing to have at dance
practice?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh! It's you, Sky!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The answer iiis... fun!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So dance with me, Flower, and you'll
have
nothing but fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky takes Nishino Flower's hand
and leads
the two of them into the first
movements of a
dance.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
One, two, turn... Now a big step. And
turn...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa... Haha! I did it!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You picked that up pretty quick, but no
surprise
there. Hmm, okay! Ready for the
spin together?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wooo! ...Heehee! This is really fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I spot Nishino Flower
smiling as
she heads to the Droite
together with Seiun Sky.
